The '''Vindicator Lockjaw''' was a model of [[Guard droid/Legends|guard droid]]. It was a four-legged machine known for being fierce when attacking. The Vindicator Lockjaw had a built-in [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], [[duramite]]-tipped fangs, and an enhanced [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package.<ref name="Game" />
